topic: prune hydrangeas without cutting off next year's blooms
core_question: When and how do I prune my hydrangeas so they still flower? (secondary: How do I compose a photo using the rule of thirds?)
answer_summary: Identify whether the hydrangea variety blooms on old wood or new wood, then prune old-wood types right after flowering (not in fall/winter) to avoid removing next year's buds.; after the topic shift: Turn on the camera's rule-of-thirds grid overlay, which divides the frame into a 3x3 grid, and position the subject or horizon along one of the grid lines or at an intersection point rather than dead center.
